_projectsIndexVisibility: auto = /projects/ index becomes indexable at 2+ published projects; index / noindex force it. Project pages themselves are indexable on publication.
_readme: Completed work. Empty by design — nothing is staged or invented. A record is published only when published:true AND permission:true (the designer has agreed, in writing, to what is shown). Each published record builds /projects/<slug>/, a card on /projects/ and on the homepage, and a sitemap entry. Media ids must exist in assets/media/manifest.json. Copy _template, fill it in, and add it to projects[].

_template.name: Villa in Jumeirah
_template.summary: One or two sentences: the room and what we made for it (max ~150 characters).
_template.brief: What the designer asked for. Paragraphs separated by a blank line.
_template.developed: What we developed: artwork, colour, construction, sampling.
